author: Corridor Crew
description:
Heroic Times (1983) is a Hungarian animated film based on the poem "Daliás idők", directed by József Gémes. What makes it really special is the medium they chose for their animation. Every single frame is an oil painting!

Can you imagine the amount of work behind it?
title: EVERY frame of this movie IS A PAINTING!
